en.headline: Family appeals for private aircraft to fly critically ill British baby home from Hong Kong
en.dek: Nine-month-old Matthew suffered three cardiac arrests after contracting influenza A during a family visit and cannot travel on commercial flights while ventilated.
body: The family of a nine-month-old British boy critically ill in a Hong Kong hospital is appealing for a donated private aircraft to fly him home for further treatment, after commercial airlines declined to carry him while he is ventilated.

Matthew, from Nottinghamshire, contracted influenza A during a family visit and suffered three cardiac arrests, leaving his brain without oxygen for an estimated 47 minutes, according to reports. He remains ventilated and marked his first birthday in hospital.

His mother, Sophia Lee, contacted Lia’s Wings, a United Kingdom charity that arranges hospital-to-hospital air transfers for children. The charity’s chief operating officer, Charlotte Young, said both Hong Kong and English clinicians agree on a transfer plan, but the cost of a private air ambulance could reach £200,000.

A specialist team of two consultants and a paediatric nurse is on standby with equipment to adapt a private jet if an aircraft becomes available. The case has drawn attention amid Hong Kong’s ongoing influenza season, which has seen multiple severe paediatric cases.

zh.headline: 英籍嬰兒染甲流危殆 家屬呼籲捐贈私人飛機送返英國
zh.dek: 九個月大男嬰馬修在港探親期間感染甲型流感並三次心跳停止，因需呼吸機無法乘搭商業航班。
body: 一名在香港醫院情況危殆的九個月大英籍男嬰家屬正呼籲捐贈私人飛機，將他送返英國接受進一步治療，因為商業航空公司拒絕載運需要呼吸機的嬰兒。
據報道，來自諾丁漢郡的馬修在探親期間感染甲型流感，其後三次心跳停止，大腦缺氧估計達47分鐘。他目前仍需呼吸機，並在醫院度過了一歲生日。
他的母親索菲娅·李聯絡了英國慈善機構Lia’s Wings，該機構專門安排兒童醫院間空中轉運。機構營運總監夏洛特·楊表示，香港及英國醫護人員已同意轉運計劃，但私人空中救護費用可能高達20萬英鎊。
兩名顧問醫生及一名兒科護士連同改裝私人飛機的設備已準備就緒，一旦有飛機可供使用便可出發。個案引起關注之際，香港流感季節仍持續，已錄得多宗兒童嚴重個案。
